title: Sunrise Social Sessions
imageAlt: Soft sunrise light over gentle waves breaking on an empty beach
excerpt: Mid-week, first light, all levels. Turn up, rotate in and start the day with sand between your toes.
description: Our Wednesday sunrise sessions are the heartbeat of the Beach Volleyball TV community. Courts go up at first light and games run on a rolling, king-of-the-court style rotation so everyone gets plenty of touches.
Whether you played last weekend or haven’t touched a ball since school, you’ll be matched into games at your level. Bring water, sunscreen and a friend.
price: Free · gold coin donation for equipment

title: Beginners’ Clinic: Fundamentals
imageAlt: A yellow and blue volleyball resting in the sand beside the court line
excerpt: Two hours on the essentials — platform passing, setting, serving and moving on sand — in small, coached groups.
description: New to beach volleyball, or coming across from indoor? This clinic builds the foundations that make the game fun: a reliable platform pass, clean hands when setting, a consistent serve and the footwork that keeps you balanced on soft sand.
Groups are capped at eight players per coach so you get real feedback, and every drill finishes with game play so the skills stick.

title: Bondi Summer Open
imageAlt: Silhouetted players leap for the ball at the net against a golden sunset
excerpt: Our flagship pairs tournament returns to Bondi — open, intermediate and mixed divisions, finals filmed for the channel.
description: The Bondi Summer Open is the biggest day on our calendar. Pairs battle through pool play in the morning before knockout rounds take over in the afternoon, with every division final filmed for Beach Volleyball TV.
Expect a packed beach, a DJ on the sand and a community that cheers just as loudly for the social division as it does for the open final.
format: Pairs — pool play, then single elimination
includes: Finals filmed and published on YouTube

title: Intermediate Clinic: Serve & Defence
imageAlt: Close-up of a yellow and blue match volleyball
excerpt: Turn your serve into a weapon and learn to read hitters — a focused session for players who already rally comfortably.
description: This clinic is for players who can hold a rally and want to start winning points. We’ll work on float and topspin serving, serving to zones, and the reading cues that put you in the right place on defence.
Expect high repetition, video feedback on your serve, and plenty of live play.

title: Christmas Charity Beach Bash
imageAlt: A lively beach crowded with colourful umbrellas and swimmers
excerpt: Fancy dress, mixed fours and a sausage sizzle — our end-of-year party on the sand, raising money for a local cause.
description: Our end-of-year celebration is all about community. Teams of four play short, silly, competitive games in their best festive outfits, with prizes for costumes as well as results.
All entry fees and donations go to a local Eastern Suburbs charity, announced closer to the day.

title: Twilight Mixed Fours League
imageAlt: Waves rolling onto the shore under a warm evening sky
excerpt: Six weeks of after-work mixed fours as the sun goes down. Weekly fixtures, a ladder and a finals night.
description: Summer evenings at Bondi don’t get better than this. The Twilight League is a six-week mixed fours competition with weekly fixtures, a live ladder and a finals night in week six.
Enter as a team or register individually and we’ll place you with players at your level.

title: Coogee King & Queen of the Beach
imageAlt: Smooth golden sand meeting clear turquoise water under a blue sky
excerpt: Individual entry, rotating partners. Every point you win is yours — crown one King and one Queen of Coogee.
description: King & Queen is the purest test on sand. You enter as an individual and play with a new partner each game, scoring individually across every round.
The top players advance to a final pool, with the last king and queen standing crowned at Coogee.

title: Australia Day Beach Cup
imageAlt: Seagulls gliding over the ocean at sunrise
excerpt: Mixed pairs on the public holiday at Maroubra. Social and competitive divisions, plenty of shade and good vibes.
description: Spend the public holiday on the sand. The Beach Cup is a mixed pairs tournament with social and competitive divisions, played across courts at Maroubra.
Pool play guarantees plenty of volleyball, and the afternoon finals are always a crowd favourite.

title: Junior Summer Camp (12–17)
imageAlt: Young volleyball players celebrating a point together
excerpt: A morning camp for young players aged 12 to 17 — skills, games and a pathway into beach volleyball.
description: Our junior camp introduces teenagers to the beach game in a fun, supportive environment. Coaches cover the core skills, then let players loose in modified games designed for lots of touches.
Parents are welcome to stay and watch. Players should bring water, a hat and sunscreen.
